title: globalShortcut unregister/register leaves both callbacks active
body:
### Electron Version

42.4.1

### What operating system(s) are you using?
Windows 11

### Expected Behavior
After unregistering Ctrl+Alt+Y and registering it again, one press should invoke only the new callback once.

### Actual Behavior
The first registration logs A. After unregister and register with callback B, every press logs A then B. isRegistered reports false between the two registrations. This happens in a fresh process without a menu accelerator. A BrowserWindow displays the logs and registrations begin in app.whenReady.

### Testcase Gist URL
https://gist.github.com/offline-fixture-owner/7a83c52eddd844219dd4014c81f09a91
